p10_b0.ocr: In the context of General Motors' ongoing efforts to optimize manufacturing plant utilization, it is essential to examine the trends reflected in the accompanying data table. p10_b1.ocr: Such figures are indicative of General Motors' strategic focus on maximizing output while maintaining cost efficiency.
